seo.title: Get in Touch | Contact 4 Lotus Interior | Studio Janakpuri & Factory Kirti Nagar
seo.meta_description: Ready to transform your space? Contact 4 Lotus Interior for expert residential and commercial interior design, decoration, and renovation services across Delhi-NCR. Get a free consultation today.
seo.og_title: Get in Touch - 4 Lotus Interior Delhi

hero.title: Get in Touch: Let's Build Your Dream Space Together
hero.description: We are committed to transparent, ethical business and delivering your residential or commercial project on time and within budget. Contact us today to start your journey.

core_services.title: We Listen First
core_services.description: Before sketching a single line, we take the time to understand your lifestyle, operational needs, personal taste, and financial parameters.

core_services.title: Turning Dreams into Reality
core_services.description: Whether it's a cozy modern apartment, an expansive luxury villa, or a high-performance office, we make sophisticated design accessible and stress-free.

core_services.title: End-to-End Solutions
core_services.description: From concept and 3D modeling to material sourcing, MEP contracting, modular joinery fabrication, and turnkey handover, we handle every detail under one roof.

core_services.title: Form Meets Function
core_services.description: Great design isn't just about beautiful renders; it's about spaces that work intuitively, feel comfortable, and endure everyday life.

design_concept.title: Direct Architectural Channels & Studio Visits
design_concept.description: Whether you have an architectural blueprint or an idea for a full turnkey makeover, our senior designers are available for direct in-person discussion at our studios or your project site.

turnkey_services.title: Our Turnkey Process
turnkey_services.subtitle: From Concept to Completion: Your Trusted Partner for Interior Projects in Delhi-NCR

cards.title: Consultation & Planning (Design Phase)
cards.description: We begin with a detailed client brief and site analysis, followed by layout planning, budgeting (BOQ), and material specifications. We then create conceptual designs, detailed drawings, and realistic 3D views for your approval.

cards.title: Execution & Delivery (Build Phase)
cards.description: Our team manages the entire construction process, including engineering drawings, project management, quality control, and cost monitoring. We ensure a smooth execution and timely handover of your finished space.

quote: Architecture is not just about making blueprints; it is about listening to how you live, work, and interact with your environment.
